steps.en: Import the function, then declare targets and parameters in one call
steps.zh: 引入函数后，一句调用声明目标与参数

steps.en: Interpolates each property every frame through the chosen ease, writing into CSS, SVG, attributes or objects
steps.zh: 每帧按所选缓动插值每个属性，写回 CSS、SVG、属性或对象

steps.en: Handles loop, stagger and callbacks, and hands back play/pause/seek controls
steps.zh: 处理循环、错峰与回调，交回 play/pause/seek 控制器

value.en: choreographed DOM/SVG/object motion with runtime controls — no requestAnimationFrame loops or easing math
value.zh: 带运行时控制器的 DOM/SVG/对象编排动效——不必手写 requestAnimationFrame 循环和缓动数学
